role_interpreted: Innocent; remembered OTTER does not match announced HIPPO. Shared answer is read publicly without its label.
public_answer: Grant wanted the salon camera off for private meetings. I followed his order. Then he said security would own any failure tonight. He wanted discretion when it suited him and somebody else's head when it did not.

experience: Provenance, restitution and donor coercion make the museum stakes engaging. The repeated Grant pressured me structure begins to make the round feel like a roster of grievances.
